title: Echo Chamber
description: A natural cavern of crystallized stone amplifies every sound into an infinite cascade of whispers. Footsteps from hours ago still reverberate off the walls, and the boundary between what is real and what is merely an echo grows impossibly thin.

choices.label: Capture the echoes
choices.description: Use a vial to trap the concentrated echo essence swirling in the chamber.

choices.label: Gather crystallized sound
choices.description: Some echoes have hardened into delicate prismatic formations on the walls.

choices.label: Listen for hidden messages
choices.description: Among the layered echoes, some carry the words of past travelers who spoke of hidden caches.

choices.label: Leave the echoes behind
choices.description: The overlapping voices are disorienting. Best to move on before losing your way.
